summary: Data collection for Automation Analytics is opted in at first license import. Configure it in Settings > Automation Execution > System with a service account (Automation Analytics Viewer role) client ID and secret and Gather data for Automation Analytics, then run a job and check console.redhat.com reports.
questions: How do I configure Automation Analytics in AAP 2.6?
What service account role is needed for Automation Analytics?
Analytics data not showing in console.redhat.com

answer_card.title: Configure Automation Analytics
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Create a service account with the **Automation Analytics Viewer** role on console.redhat.com.
2. **Settings > Automation Execution > System > Edit**: enter **Red Hat Client ID for Analytics** and **Client Secret**, tick **Gather data for Automation Analytics**, **Save**.
3. Run a job and check reports at console.redhat.com/ansible/automation-analytics.
